thread:
Priya: quick async standup — what I did: rolled a small batcher patch to reduce tail latency on p2 instances, added extra metrics for per-request sequencing depth
Priya: blockers: seeing intermittent 504s when requests have seq_len > 8, not consistent across regions — suspect batching corner-case or KV-cache serialization
Priya: today: run controlled ramp in staging -> prod (20% -> 50%), add request-scoped logs, create a synthetic load test for seq_len distribution, and open an SLO regression ticket if we see drift
Sam: saw the 504s in the alert traces, looks like a timeout at the inter-op boundary after batching; can you paste a sample request-id and relevant log snippet?
Priya: here's an example trace id: req-2026-03-17-8f3b2c. Relevant log around the failure:
```
[2026-03-17T05:12:23Z] req=req-2026-03-17-8f3b2c batch_size=16 seq_len=12 backend=gv100 latency_ms=1200 err=timeout
stack: serve->batcher->kv-lookup->serialize
```
Priya: attaching the trace link: https://observability.internal/traces/req-2026-03-17-8f3b2c
Diego: thanks — initial thought: when seq_len>8 we cross a batching threshold that changes kernel selection, maybe a fallback path trips a lock. Try disabling multi-request merging for seq_len>8 as a mitigation (config flag `batcher.merge_threshold`)
Diego: quick patch to test (apply in staging):
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/batcher BATCHER_MERGE_THRESHOLD=9
```
Priya: will run that on staging now, then ramp if green.
Morgan: I'll open an SLO check ticket and attach current alert burn rate graphs. If we cross 2x baseline we should page oncall for escalation. I'll link the ticket here once created.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0317-42 (automated from alert rule alert:batcher.504.rate high) — responders: @oncall-primary
oncall-bot: incident status: acknowledged by @Sam
Sam: small follow-ups — can we add a synthetic test to the nightly canary job that hits seq_len distribution {1:50%, 4:30%, 10:20%}? Example curl snippet for the synthetic runner:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api/redwood/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SYNTH_KEY" -d '{"seq_len":10,"batchable":true}'
```
Sam: also recommend bumping request log retention for these traces to 7d while we triage (so we don't lose the events).
Priya: ack — I'll create two PRs: 1) disable merge threshold in staging + runtime flag; 2) bump retention and add extra fields (seq_len, batch_id) to request logs. PRs will reference INC-2026-0317-42.
Diego: if staging looks good, let's schedule a phased prod ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 60% with 15-minute observation windows. If any export pipeline shows >3% 504s revert to CPU fallback route.
Morgan: noted — I'll add the ramp schedule to the incident and ping platform to reserve capacity for the CPU fallback path.
Priya: thanks team — running the staging patch now. will update in ~15m with results. :thumbsup:
